fusions.name: Misdirected Shaft
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Through the Gap
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 14 damage and leaving the target [Exposed] for 6 seconds. They ignore resistances.

fusions.name: Vanish Behind
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and speeds you up by 15% while it lasts. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Pickpocket's Eye
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
